name: dsh-ru-ui
description: Russian interface translation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): registers complete ru dictionaries for the DSH platform and its plugins, adds Russian to the language picker, and activates it on first run. Translation only — no typography, spell-check or layout-fix extras.

scripts.refresh: DSH_APP="${DSH_APP:-/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app}" DSH_PROFILE="${DSH_PROFILE:-$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules}" sh -c 'python3 tools/extract_en.py "$DSH_APP" build/en-core.json && python3 tools/extract_en.py "$DSH_PROFILE" build/en-plugins.json && python3 tools/build_ru.py && python3 tools/gen_dict_js.py'
